description: This file defines the Controller class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, including nested classes, configuration structures, and method declarations for plugin control, web handling, and system management.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main plugin controller class implementing multiple interfaces for plugin management, web handling, and JSON RPC communication.

classes.name: Controller::Sink
classes.description: Notification sink class handling plugin and subsystem notifications, scheduling subsystem updates.

classes.name: Controller::Config
classes.description: Configuration container class with nested ProbeConfig for plugin settings.

classes.name: Controller::Config::ProbeConfig
classes.description: Nested class for probe-specific configuration parameters.

classes.name: Controller::Job
classes.description: Dispatchable job class used within Sink for scheduling subsystem updates.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes plugin data at a specified path.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Hibernates a plugin with a timeout.

methods.name: FromIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a service object based on a callsign.

methods.name: event_all
methods.description: Broadcasts an event to all subscribers.

methods.name: event_statechange
methods.description: Notifies about a plugin's state change.
